lead: A form in a dialog: the same as `FormDrawer`, centered on the page. Use it for a few fields; a longer form is better in a drawer.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Closing is yours: close it in `onSubmit` once the save worked.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.composed: FormDialog is Dialog + Form + Button and has no slot of its own: its look comes from the theme styles of those components.
